notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,



It's now official: early access for Bakery Cafe Simulator is set for July 8! 🎉



I can't wait to show you all the new features I've been working on, and that we'll be continuing to work on after this release!





Here's a sneak preview of the new recipes and ingredients you'll find in the game when it is released in early access. Of course, many more will be added over the coming months. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415750/96de2fdde4399ae44a221398af84390441101592.png"] This early access is an opportunity to continue co-constructing the game together, as we've been doing since the release of the first version of our demo. 





From July 8 and for one week, you'll be able to get Bakery Cafe Simulator for less than $10 (almost half the price of an espresso in the game ) and enjoy all the new recipes, employee system, new furniture and much more! Dont miss that opportunity 😁



Thanks in advance to everyone who will trust me by buying the game when it comes out 💚🙏



Cédric

notes.title: Demo content Update - Steam Fest
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,



Yesterday was the start of Steam Fest, and I'm happy to announce that Bakery Cafe Simulator is part of it!



To celebrate the news, we're pleased to offer you an exclusive content update for the game's demo.

You'll find a new beverage, the caramel latte, as well as two pieces of equipment that have been very much in demand by the community: a more efficient coffee maker allowing you to store up to 2L of coffee in advance, and a storage rack for your plates.



!! This content update is available exclusively on the demo and not on the prologue.



In parallel, the game's development is progressing well and I'll be happy to share the progress with you very soon.



Wishing you a good day and a great festival!

Cédric from Meerkatt Studio

notes.title: Prologue - Patch #07
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

New day, new patch !

For today' patch, some QoL, bugfixes and the end of griefers joining your game :

 Fixing an issue causing griefers to be able to join your game without having the password
 Clients in multiplayers had issues with edit mode
 You can now use Escape to exit the cash register
 You can now use left click to clean trays
 You can know set all the key binding of the game
 A security has been added to send you a warning if the key you try to bind is used somewhere else
 You can now put open boxes in the trash


Have a nice day,

Cédric from Meerkatt Studio

notes.title: Prologue - Patch #03

Hi everyone,

New day, new patch !

For today' patch :

- A lot of change on the performances/brightness > If you had lag, try the new "Medium" graphical settings (which is now set by default)
- Removed the multiplayer lobby, now you join directly in the game
- Cash register issues with the ghost customers are normally gone

Don't hesitate to send me your feedback on the performance aspect, I'm curious to know if the game now runs better on your computer and if people who were playing on “Low” have been able to switch to “Medium” 😁🙏

Have a nice day,
